decisions.reason: Deducting applicable fiat fees from the founder's proceeds changes revenue allocation, not the Transak provider, payment flow, supported methods, or wallet requirement.
The founder's fiat-fee treatment does not change which asset must be minted or the mint-fulfillment behavior.
The candidate's existing message-146 MODIFY already states that the client earns $4 per sale minus fiat fees, so no additional or corrected Event is required.
The fiat-fee deduction from founder proceeds does not alter winner eligibility, ticket weighting, randomness, fairness, or verification.
The fee-allocation change does not alter the mint number's role as a permanent referral code or its display locations.
The founder's fiat-fee treatment does not change the no-code trigger, random-recipient eligibility, commission amount, or ticket award.
The revenue-allocation detail does not change confirmation-email availability or contents.
The source preserves that remaining revenue funds commissions and prize pools; it does not change the candidate's funding sale types, duration, or secondary-royalty rule.
The treatment of fiat fees in founder proceeds does not alter email authentication, dashboard access, magic links, or intended users.
The fee-allocation change does not alter referral badge conditions or milestone thresholds.
The founder's fiat-fee treatment has no effect on the deferred Discord community-server requirement.
The fee-allocation change does not alter manual prize claiming, winner announcements, or the one-click claim interaction.
